notes.title: Crystalfall made it onto the ARPG timeline!
notes.notes:
[p]Thrilled to see our game listed on the [b]ARPG timeline[/b] alongside top-tier ARPGs like [b]Path of Exile, Diablo 2 Resurrected[/b], and newly released games [b]Titan Quest 2[/b] and [b]Hell Clock[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45298371/c04ee35df860637de6f41d7cec45e637673d835f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]With our game now on Steam, Epic Games, and the ARPG timeline, it all feels so much more real. As an indie team it is incredily rewarding and heart-warming to see Crystalfall alongside the games we have loved and played for so long. 
[/p][p]Now that Crystalfall is on the ARPG radar, it'll be easier to track the release date of our game and maybe even schedule a vacation around it!
[/p][p]A big thank you to everyone for supporting our team - it means the world to us! We can't wait to drop some more announcements soon with the latest news from the game. 
[/p][p]Join the conversation on Reddit or Discord to talk to our team or other members in the community. 
[/p][p][b]Link to the ARPG timeline:[/b] [url="https://www.arpg-timeline.com/"]https://www.arpg-timeline.com/[/url]

notes.title: Thank you for 20K+ wishlists!
notes.notes:
[p]We are beyond happy to announce that we now have over 20K wishlists!  

Our team is thrilled to see how the interest in our game has grown. We are so thankful to our community for supporting us and are as eager as you are to see the game go live later this year.

As we approach our planned release, we will begin making announcements and game updates here on Steam. For daily updates on the development progress, join our community on Reddit or Discord, where we hold game nights, forum discussions and polls. 

Since we have an open development process, we share a lot of behind the scenes content with our devs working on different features. In our community, you can give feedback on everything from concept art to animations and boss design. 

If you have any questions about our game or team, feel free to ask through any of our social channels:

[url="https://www.reddit.com/r/Crystalfall/"]r/Crystalfall[/url][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/ntPmauYuKV"]Crystalfall Discord Server[/url] [/p][p][url="https://www.youtube.com/@PlayCrystalfall"]Youtube Channel[/url]
